scope: One permanent six-axis gun positioner and its observation setup. Prime price anchors were observed in signed-in Chrome. Other rows are engineering/fabrication allowances, not quotations or selected parts. Excludes labor, tax, development replacements, computer, welding equipment, existing rotator and formal calibration service. Independent-reference and optional-diagnostic groups are separate from the initial positioner/observation total.

positioner.purpose: Five of the six screw-drive motors. Holding torque is not a continuous operating rating.

positioner.evidence: Prime price observed; selected single-motor option
positioner.purpose: The sixth screw-drive motor; avoids buying unused motors in a second five-pack.

positioner.evidence: Prime price and six-pack option observed; board pinout and thermal behavior require verification
positioner.purpose: All six step/direction channels with UART diagnostics; fixed settings during response learning.

positioner.item: Six M6x1 steel screws and twelve metal nuts
positioner.evidence: Allowance including cutting/finishing and adjustable paired-nut carriers; straightness and wear unqualified
positioner.purpose: Three approximately 300 mm linear screws and three angular actuators with 90–100 mm length-change allowance; printed carriers hold metal nuts.

positioner.item: XYZ metal guides and bearing blocks
positioner.evidence: Allowance for six approximately 350–400 mm guides and twelve blocks; actual guide type, clearance and moment capacity not selected
positioner.purpose: Two guides/four blocks per slide, provisionally 200 mm usable mechanical travel each.

positioner.evidence: Allowance for approximately fifteen bearing units: three per long linear screw and two per pivoted angular screw; actual combined-load/preload arrangement not selected
positioner.purpose: Carry thrust and belt side-load independently of motor bearings; floating-end radial support on the long linear screws.

positioner.item: Gimbal output bearings, shafts and spacers
positioner.evidence: Allowance for three shafts and six output bearings; type, span and preload require sizing
positioner.purpose: Carry gun and gimbal moments independently of the angular screw transmission.

positioner.evidence: Allowance for metal pins, bearing/contact parts and retainers in printed carriers; friction and capacity unqualified
positioner.purpose: Two articulated ends per angular screw; accommodate lever motion and prevent nut co-rotation.

positioner.evidence: Allowance for six belts, six purchased small pinions and metal shaft interfaces; large pulleys printed
positioner.purpose: Reduce motor motion into screw travel. Pitch, width, wrap and tension remain to be selected.

positioner.item: Motion controller, six carrier sockets and pulse/UART interfaces
positioner.evidence: Allowance for a controller implementation with two addressed UART buses or a multiplexer; complete board not selected
positioner.purpose: Six coordinated bounded axes, homing, driver state, timestamps and watchdog.

positioner.item: 24 V power supply, wiring, connectors, fusing, homing/limits and stop interfaces
positioner.evidence: Allowance; supply capacity and electrical interfaces remain to be sized
positioner.purpose: Power and monitor the one six-axis positioner.

positioner.item: Common metal base, short frame, carriage plates and gimbal backbones
positioner.evidence: Allowance for cut/drilled stock and clamp interfaces using existing shop tools
positioner.purpose: Braced station load paths, bearing-seat support and alignment with rotator/measurement references.

positioner.item: Fixed gun-clamp pads, straps and mount interfaces
positioner.purpose: Retain the gun on the positioner throughout dry runs and welding.
Through-bolted structural joints and serviceable printed parts.
Gun shell, large pulleys, nut/bearing carriers, guards and locators. Application-specific strength and wear remain unqualified.

positioner.item: Adjustable preload, gravity balance and positive retention
positioner.evidence: Allowance; spring and retention capacities not established
positioner.purpose: Manage thread-flank contact and holding heat; retain gravity axes through power loss without assuming self-locking screws.

positioner.evidence: Allowance; jam-force limit and response require engineering
positioner.purpose: Address forces from blocked high-reduction screws; 200 N normal-force sizing is not a jam-force rating.
Lubrication, thread treatment and electrical assembly supplies.

observation.purpose: Two calibrated views of actual wire endpoint, dot, seam and rigid gun references; existing camera supplies overview.
Approximately 109 mm optical working distance at infinity focus; complete optical measurement uncertainty unqualified.

observation.item: Rigid camera/lens carriages and retract/return datums
observation.purpose: Keep optics together during tube loading and recover measurement geometry.

observation.item: Separate cable boom and sliding/swiveling liner support
observation.purpose: Support the heavy umbilical and long near-straight wire approach from the opposite edge.

observation.evidence: Allowance; live-emission optical protection/filtering not yet designed
observation.purpose: Stable imagery and native-resolution acquisition; further live-weld optical materials may be required.

independent_reference.item: Independent displacement reference and calibration fixture
independent_reference.evidence: Separate allowance; instrument selection and assembled uncertainty not established
independent_reference.purpose: Validate camera localization and achieved physical motion independently. Does not prevent initial dry learning from starting.

optional_diagnostics.evidence: Prime price observed; module identity and SPI diagnostics require verification
optional_diagnostics.purpose: Optional screw-shaft/stall diagnostics; does not measure nut travel, compliance, gun or seam directly.
Optional encoder targets; alignment and field quality require verification.
